args.subject: Harbor Health Mercury quote decision
args.body:
Hi Sarah,

For Harbor Health, please quote Mercury based on 63 monthly active developers, not the 180 purchased seats. Directory or purchased-seat counts shouldn’t drive the quote when actual usage is available.

Please keep this on standard Mercury terms and do not add a one-off enterprise exception or custom carveout.

Best,
Morgan Chen · Co-Founder & CEO, Scaffold
